note: comma.ai talks about running a 4PB local cluster. It looks like they're focusing on self driving cars? Tinybox pro v2 (2cpu, 8gpu) for compute, dell r630 + r730 with SSDs (~4PB), 3 100Gbps z9264f switches, 2 infiniband switches. Servers have ubuntu with pxeboot managed by salt. Storage use mkv (~1TB/s), ~300TB cache. Slurm for workload management mostly running pytorch and miniray (lightweight custom task scheduler).
